description: Use when an agent needs to look up what it already knows before doing new work, or when an operator wants the facts behind a past decision. Covers query patterns (keyword choice, kind filters, tag and agent filters), how the memory-store relevance ranking works, interpreting confidence and staleness, and recalling procedural knowledge mid-task. Use when starting any scan, investigation, or incident, when verifying a claim, or when drafting a report that depends on earlier findings.
